inspection_reason: Resolve the canonical QC2-019 candidate inspection queue using revision-pinned source evidence before deciding whether each item can be represented safely by the existing daily-feature Runner Protocol contract.

decisions.source_supported_meaning: Pinned code computes 10-, 5-, and 1-session rate of change, a 10-session ROC z-score, and ROC acceleration; branches at absolute z-scores 2.5/1.5 and compares absolute acceleration with twice the absolute mean. Source comments call it momentum analysis.
useful_concepts: No concept is adopted while the T34 historical identity conflict remains unresolved and no matching registered ROC-z-score feature exists.
decisions.source_tests: Shared Apex candidate test only; no candidate behavior asserted; NOT_RUN.
conflicts: QC2-001 records that the tier document labels T34 Strength zone mapping while the pinned implementation is rate-of-change momentum.
The proposed historical trap-evader identity remains unresolved.
decisions.license: Apex demo/evaluation only; no production/live use without written consent.
decisions.exclusion_reason: The historical identity conflict is unresolved; the inspected z-score implementation uses NumPy/binary floats and has no directly corresponding registered daily feature. No source thresholds or float behavior are carried over.

decisions.source_supported_meaning: 14-bar Williams %R; overbought above -20, oversold below -80, and a momentum-shift branch when absolute five-observation trend change exceeds 20.
useful_concepts: Oscillator saturation and reversal may inform a future feature review, but Williams %R is not available as a registered F0 feature.
decisions.source_tests: Shared Apex candidate test only; no candidate behavior asserted; NOT_RUN.
conflicts: The pinned implementation uses NumPy/binary floats and source thresholds.
No Williams %R feature is registered in the QC2-014 daily feature set.
decisions.license: Apex demo/evaluation only; no production/live use without written consent.
decisions.exclusion_reason: The existing declarative runner consumes registered scalar features and cannot compute the required rolling high/low oscillator without broadening the feature/runtime architecture. No equivalent registered feature exists.

decisions.source_supported_meaning: 20-session CCI over typical price and mean absolute deviation; branches at +200/+100/-200/-100 and when absolute five-observation CCI trend exceeds 100.
useful_concepts: CCI extremes may inform a future feature review, but the required rolling typical-price and deviation calculation is not registered.
decisions.source_tests: Shared Apex candidate test only; no candidate behavior asserted; NOT_RUN.
conflicts: The pinned implementation uses NumPy/binary floats and source thresholds.
No CCI or typical-price mean-deviation feature is registered in the QC2-014 daily feature set.
decisions.license: Apex demo/evaluation only; no production/live use without written consent.
decisions.exclusion_reason: No exact registered daily feature supports the source calculation, and implementing its rolling statistic in the protocol runner would broaden the authorized architecture.

decisions.source_supported_meaning: Daily volume spike/dry-up classification from current volume divided by a 20-bar mean and a volume z-score: ratio >3 with z-score >2.5, ratio >2, ratio >1.5, or ratio <0.5. Price change is calculated for output details but does not affect the branch decision.
useful_concepts: Compare current volume with a prior-only baseline using registered relative_volume; source z-scores and legacy threshold branches are not transferred.
decisions.source_tests: Shared Apex candidate test only; no candidate behavior asserted; NOT_RUN.
conflicts: The pinned denominator includes the current bar; QC2-014 relative_volume uses the preceding 20 sessions.
The source's 1.5/2.0/3.0 ratio and z-score thresholds are not calibrated for QC2 and are not reused.
The pinned implementation uses NumPy/binary floats.
decisions.license: Apex demo/evaluation only; no production/live use without written consent.
decisions.semantics_difference: The research-only rewrite asks only whether exact registered relative_volume exceeds 1.000000000000, meaning today's volume is above the prior-20-session arithmetic mean. It omits source z-scores, source thresholds, price-change detail, and any calibrated confidence. The original T41 behavior is not reproduced.

decisions.source_supported_meaning: Cumulative On-Balance Volume with divergence, current-vs-20-bar-mean comparisons at 1.2/0.8, and a normalized-slope branch above 0.5.
useful_concepts: Volume direction can be considered alongside price trend in principle, but no registered OBV feature supports this source behavior.
decisions.source_tests: Shared Apex candidate test only; no candidate behavior asserted; NOT_RUN.
conflicts: The pinned implementation uses NumPy/binary floats and source thresholds.
QC2-014 has no OBV feature; the registered accumulation feature is not OBV and is not treated as equivalent.
decisions.license: Apex demo/evaluation only; no production/live use without written consent.
decisions.exclusion_reason: There is no registered exact OBV feature or pointwise equivalent. Replacing OBV with a different accumulation feature would misstate source semantics.

decisions.source_supported_meaning: Cumulative Accumulation/Distribution line using close-location multiplier times volume, with 10/20-bar moving-average comparisons at 1.1/0.9 and 10-bar price-divergence branches.
useful_concepts: Close-location weighting by volume is relevant to the registered finite accumulation feature, but that feature is not the source's cumulative A/D line.
decisions.source_tests: Shared Apex candidate test only; no candidate behavior asserted; NOT_RUN.
conflicts: The pinned implementation uses NumPy/binary floats and source thresholds.
QC2-014 accumulation is a finite 20-session volume-weighted close-location fraction, not the source's cumulative A/D line or its moving-average comparison.
decisions.license: Apex demo/evaluation only; no production/live use without written consent.
decisions.semantics_difference: The research-only rewrite tests whether the exact registered 20-session normalized accumulation feature is positive. It does not reproduce a cumulative line, source moving averages, divergence, thresholds, or confidence.

decisions.source_supported_meaning: Cup-and-handle pattern over 50 closes; rim similarity <5%, cup depth 10–35%, handle pullback 5–15%, and a potential-cup branch.
useful_concepts: The source expresses a staged price-shape hypothesis, but no exact registered daily shape feature supports it.
decisions.source_tests: Shared Apex candidate test only; no candidate behavior asserted; NOT_RUN.
conflicts: The pinned implementation uses NumPy/binary floats and source pattern thresholds.
The registered feature set has no exact cup/handle shape feature.
decisions.license: Apex demo/evaluation only; no production/live use without written consent.
decisions.exclusion_reason: The pattern's rolling extrema and staged shape comparisons are not represented by registered scalar daily features. Adding a pattern evaluator would broaden the protocol architecture.

decisions.source_supported_meaning: Mean-reversion score combines current deviation/volatility with a historical reversion rate; the top branch requires absolute z-score >2.5 and reversion rate >0.5, with lesser branches above 2 and 1.5.
useful_concepts: No concept is adopted because the historical rate uses future closes and the required current-window z-score is not a registered feature.
decisions.source_tests: Shared Apex candidate test only; no candidate behavior asserted; NOT_RUN.
conflicts: The historical-rate loop reads closes[i+5] to calculate a future five-session return.
The implementation uses NumPy/binary floats and has no matching registered mean-reversion z-score feature.
decisions.license: Apex demo/evaluation only; no production/live use without written consent.
decisions.exclusion_reason: Its historical-reversion component contains future-memory/lookahead and cannot be used for a point-in-time Runner Protocol. The remaining current-window statistic is not available as a registered feature.

decisions.source_supported_meaning: Trend-continuation score uses 10/20-session return-sign alignment, recent/prior volume support, pullback <3%, and weighted components 0.3/0.25/0.25/0.2 with branches above 0.7 and 0.5.
useful_concepts: Multi-horizon return-sign alignment is independently testable from registered return_10 and return_20; other source score components are omitted.
decisions.source_tests: Shared Apex candidate test only; no candidate behavior asserted; NOT_RUN.
conflicts: The source's volume windows and pullback measurement do not match an exact registered feature contract.
The source's 3% and weighted-score thresholds are not calibrated for QC2 and are not reused.
The pinned implementation uses NumPy/binary floats.
decisions.license: Apex demo/evaluation only; no production/live use without written consent.
decisions.semantics_difference: The research-only rewrite tests only whether registered 10- and 20-session returns share a sign, including both being exactly zero. It omits volume support, pullback depth, weighted score, source thresholds, and confidence; it is not equivalent to T78.
